phases.title: Python, Engineering Foundations and Data Access
phases.summary: Write, test and debug real Python against a real database.
phases.deliverable: A structured Python application with PostgreSQL integration, validation, logging and automated tests.
phases.exit_gate: Independently understand, modify, debug and test the application.

phases.title: APIs, Integrations and LLM Applications
phases.summary: Expose data through a real API and add reliable, structured LLM analysis.
phases.deliverable: A backend application that exposes finance data through APIs and uses an LLM to generate validated, structured analysis.
phases.exit_gate: Build and test an API-driven LLM application with reliable structured outputs, error handling and cost visibility.

phases.title: RAG and Enterprise Knowledge Systems
phases.summary: Answer questions from approved documents with citations you can check.
phases.deliverable: An enterprise knowledge assistant that answers questions from approved documents with verifiable citations.
phases.exit_gate: Demonstrate retrieval quality, source grounding, access-aware search and measurable answer quality.

phases.title: Agentic AI, LangGraph and MCP
phases.summary: Build stateful agents with controlled tools and a human in the loop.
phases.deliverable: A multi-step finance operations agent that investigates exceptions, gathers evidence, recommends actions and requests approval before consequential actions.
phases.exit_gate: Demonstrate a stateful, observable agent workflow with controlled tools, persistence and human approval.

phases.title: AI Evaluation, Security and Deployment
phases.summary: Prove quality, defend the system and ship it.
phases.deliverable: A secured, evaluated and deployed AI application with tracing, tests, access controls and operational monitoring.
phases.exit_gate: Demonstrate repeatable evaluation, security controls and a working deployment.

phases.title: Advanced Architecture, Integrations and Reliability
phases.summary: Grow from one app to an integrated, reliable departmental solution.
phases.deliverable: An integrated departmental AI solution with multiple data sources, controlled tools, reliable workflows and operational documentation.
phases.exit_gate: Independently explain and troubleshoot the application's components, integrations, failure modes and trade-offs.

phases.title: Enterprise AI Architecture and Production Ownership
phases.summary: Design, defend, deploy and operate a business AI solution.
phases.deliverable: A production-style departmental AI solution with architecture documentation, secure deployment, monitoring, CI/CD, governance and an operating model.
phases.exit_gate: Design, defend, deploy and operate a business AI solution, explaining architecture choices, security, cost, reliability and measurable business value.

milestones.title: Python engineering and validation
milestones.business_problem: Month-end reconciliation files arrive in inconsistent shapes and are checked by hand.
milestones.technical_objective: A structured Python package that loads, validates and logs ledger and bank extracts.
milestones.completion_criteria: Invalid rows are rejected with reasons; pytest suite covers validators; logging is configurable.

milestones.title: Database and data access
milestones.business_problem: Reconciliation history lives in spreadsheets and cannot be queried.
milestones.technical_objective: PostgreSQL schema for entities, accounts, transactions and matches, with a data-access layer.
milestones.completion_criteria: Constraints enforce integrity; window-function reports reproduce a known month; tests use a test database.

milestones.title: APIs and integrations
milestones.business_problem: Finance colleagues need reconciliation status without opening files.
milestones.technical_objective: FastAPI service with authenticated endpoints, idempotent imports and webhooks.
milestones.completion_criteria: OpenAPI documented; auth enforced; re-posting the same import is a no-op; API tests pass.

milestones.title: LLM-powered analysis
milestones.business_problem: Explaining unmatched items and variances takes analysts hours each close.
milestones.technical_objective: LLM analysis that returns schema-validated variance explanations with cost and latency logged.
milestones.completion_criteria: Outputs validate against a JSON schema; failures retry or degrade; per-call cost is recorded.

milestones.title: RAG and knowledge retrieval
milestones.business_problem: Accounting policies and close procedures are scattered across PDFs.
milestones.technical_objective: pgvector knowledge assistant over approved policy documents with citations.
milestones.completion_criteria: Answers cite exact chunks; access filters respected; a retrieval eval set reports recall.

milestones.title: Agent workflows
milestones.business_problem: Exception investigation follows the same evidence-gathering steps every month.
milestones.technical_objective: LangGraph agent that investigates exceptions, gathers evidence and recommends actions.
milestones.completion_criteria: State persists across interrupts; consequential actions wait for human approval; runs are replayable.

milestones.title: MCP tools
milestones.business_problem: Each new tool integration is bespoke and hard to govern.
milestones.technical_objective: An MCP server exposing ledger lookups and match proposals with permission boundaries.
milestones.completion_criteria: Tools, resources and prompts declared; read and write tools separated; client integration tested.

milestones.title: Evaluation and observability
milestones.business_problem: Nobody can say whether a prompt change made the analysis better or worse.
milestones.technical_objective: Golden datasets, automated evals and Langfuse tracing across the pipeline.
milestones.completion_criteria: Regression suite runs in CI with thresholds; traces show cost, tokens and latency per run.

milestones.title: Security and access control
milestones.business_problem: Finance data is sensitive and entity access must be restricted.
milestones.technical_objective: RBAC, input/output validation, prompt-injection defences and audit logging.
milestones.completion_criteria: OWASP LLM Top 10 threat model written; injection tests pass; every action is audited.

milestones.title: Enterprise deployment and architecture
milestones.business_problem: The solution must run as a supported departmental service.
milestones.technical_objective: Azure Container Apps deployment with Entra ID, CI/CD, monitoring, C4 diagrams and ADRs.
milestones.completion_criteria: Deployed via pipeline with rollback; architecture defended in writing; runbook and operating model exist.

topics.title: Python engineering
topics.objective: Write modular, typed, testable Python that a colleague can read.
topics.summary: Move from scripts to software: data structures, functions, classes and composition, errors, type hints, packaging, configuration and async basics.
topics.assignment: Build the LedgerSync loader package: typed models for ledger and bank lines, a validator that rejects bad rows with reasons, configuration from environment variables, and a CLI entry point.

topics.title: Software engineering
topics.objective: Work like an engineer: version control, tests, logs and code review.
topics.summary: Git workflows, project structure, debugging and logging, and pytest with fixtures, parametrisation and mocks — plus critically reviewing AI-generated code.
topics.assignment: Put LedgerSync under Git with a feature-branch workflow; reach meaningful pytest coverage of the validators using fixtures and parametrised cases; review one AI-generated function and record the defects you found.

topics.title: SQL and database foundations
topics.objective: Model, query and protect relational data in PostgreSQL.
topics.summary: Querying from joins to window functions, relational modelling with keys and constraints, transactions, indexing and connecting from Python.
topics.assignment: Design the LedgerSync schema in PostgreSQL; write an anti-join that finds unmatched transactions and a window-function report of running balances; load data from Python inside a transaction.

topics.title: Backend engineering
topics.objective: Build authenticated, tested, idempotent HTTP APIs.
topics.summary: HTTP and REST, FastAPI with Pydantic validation, SQLAlchemy and Alembic, OAuth2/JWT/OIDC fundamentals, webhooks, retries and idempotency.
topics.assignment: Wrap LedgerSync in FastAPI: authenticated endpoints for imports and match status, Alembic migrations, an idempotency key on imports, and an API test suite.

topics.title: LLM engineering
topics.objective: Call models deliberately: right model, right cost, structured and safe outputs.
topics.summary: How LLMs work, tokens and context windows, model selection, sampling, cost and latency, provider APIs, streaming, structured outputs, tool calling and provider abstraction.
topics.assignment: Add a variance-explanation endpoint that calls two providers behind one interface, validates output against a JSON schema, retries on rate limits and logs token cost per call.

topics.title: Prompt and context engineering
topics.objective: Construct context and instructions that produce grounded, testable outputs.
topics.summary: System instructions, prompt structure, few-shot examples, context construction, output constraints, grounding, prompt testing and injection basics.
topics.assignment: Write a versioned prompt for variance analysis with few-shot examples drawn from real close scenarios, a test set of 20 cases, and two injection attempts that must fail.

topics.title: Knowledge ingestion
topics.objective: Turn messy documents into clean, attributed, searchable chunks.
topics.summary: PDF and document extraction, normalisation, metadata, ingestion pipelines and structured-data ingestion.
topics.assignment: Ingest a set of accounting-policy PDFs and a close checklist spreadsheet into normalised chunks carrying source, page, owner and access metadata.

topics.title: Retrieval engineering
topics.objective: Retrieve the right passages, measurably.
topics.summary: Embeddings, similarity search, chunking strategies, metadata filters, pgvector, semantic and hybrid search, reranking fundamentals.
topics.assignment: Index the policy chunks in pgvector; compare two chunking strategies and semantic versus hybrid search on a 30-question retrieval set; record recall@5 for each.

topics.title: RAG architecture
topics.objective: Ground generation in retrieved sources and prove it.
topics.summary: Retrieval pipelines, context assembly, grounded generation, citations, access-aware retrieval, retrieval quality, RAG evaluation and failure analysis.
topics.assignment: Ship the policy assistant: answers with chunk-level citations, refusal when sources are missing, entity-based access filters, and a written failure analysis of ten wrong answers.

topics.title: Agent engineering
topics.objective: Know when to build a workflow and when an agent, and build either well.
topics.summary: Workflows versus agents, agent loops, planning, tool selection, state, context and memory, human-in-the-loop and recovery.
topics.assignment: Write a one-page design for the exception-investigation agent: which steps are fixed workflow, which are agentic, which tools exist and where a human must approve.

topics.title: LangGraph
topics.objective: Implement durable, interruptible graphs.
topics.summary: Nodes, edges and state, conditional routing, checkpointing and persistence, interrupts and approval, long-running and resumable workflows, testing.
topics.assignment: Implement the investigation agent in LangGraph with a Postgres checkpointer, an approval interrupt before any write, and tests that resume a run after a simulated crash.

topics.title: MCP
topics.objective: Expose and consume tools through the Model Context Protocol safely.
topics.summary: MCP architecture (hosts, clients, servers), tools, resources and prompts, server and client development, authentication and permission boundaries.
topics.assignment: Build a LedgerSync MCP server with read-only lookup tools, a separately permissioned match-proposal tool, and connect it to the LangGraph agent and one desktop client.

topics.title: Reliable agent execution
topics.objective: Make agent actions safe, auditable and repeatable.
topics.summary: Tool permissions, approval gates, input validation, idempotency, retries, audit trails, safe execution and failure handling.
topics.assignment: Add an audit trail for every tool call, idempotency keys on write tools, and a failure-injection test that proves no action is executed twice or without approval.

topics.title: AI evaluation
topics.objective: Measure AI quality with datasets and thresholds, not impressions.
topics.summary: Evaluation fundamentals, golden datasets, test design, deterministic checks, LLM-as-judge, RAG and agent-trajectory evaluation, regression testing and automation.
topics.assignment: Build golden datasets for variance analysis, policy Q&A and the agent; automate deterministic and judge-based evals with pass thresholds that block a regression.

topics.title: Observability
topics.objective: See what every AI call did, cost and took.
topics.summary: Langfuse tracing, prompt versioning, token and cost tracking, latency monitoring, error analysis and performance monitoring.
topics.assignment: Instrument LedgerSync with Langfuse traces across API, RAG and agent; version prompts; produce a weekly cost and latency summary from real traces.

topics.title: Security
topics.objective: Threat-model and defend an LLM application.
topics.summary: OWASP LLM Top 10, direct and indirect prompt injection, data exposure and leakage, RBAC and least privilege, secrets, validation, access-controlled retrieval and audit logging.
topics.assignment: Write a threat model mapped to the OWASP LLM Top 10; add RBAC per entity; plant an indirect injection in a policy document and prove the assistant does not follow it.

topics.title: Deployment foundations
topics.objective: Package and run the application outside your laptop.
topics.summary: Linux and CLI, Docker and containerisation, environment configuration, cloud and CI/CD fundamentals, automated testing before deployment, monitoring and recovery.
topics.assignment: Containerise LedgerSync with Docker Compose (API, Postgres, worker), run tests in CI before a deploy step, and document a restore-from-backup drill you actually performed.

topics.title: Advanced application architecture
topics.objective: Draw and defend service boundaries.
topics.summary: Modular architecture, service boundaries, separation of concerns, API architecture, event-driven integration, background and asynchronous workflows, orchestration and integration patterns.
topics.assignment: Split LedgerSync's long-running imports and agent runs into background workers with a queue; write an ADR justifying the boundaries you chose.

topics.title: Enterprise integrations
topics.objective: Connect safely to the systems a department already runs.
topics.summary: Identity providers, external APIs, webhooks, business application integrations, enterprise data sources, permission-aware tool access and system-to-system communication.
topics.assignment: Integrate a second real data source (for example an ERP extract or a banking feed sandbox) with service-to-service auth and permission-aware tool access.

topics.title: Reliability engineering
topics.objective: Keep the solution working when its dependencies fail.
topics.summary: Retries and backoff, idempotency, timeouts, rate limiting, model fallback, circuit breakers, state recovery, backups, incidents and runbooks.
topics.assignment: Add timeouts, backoff, a model fallback and a circuit breaker around the LLM provider; run a game-day where the provider fails and write the incident review and runbook.

topics.title: Advanced RAG and agent design
topics.objective: Optimise retrieval and agents against measured quality, cost and latency.
topics.summary: Retrieval optimisation, hybrid retrieval and reranking, query transformation, agent evaluation, workflow optimisation, approval design, tool reliability, cost and latency optimisation.
topics.assignment: Use the eval suite to improve one RAG and one agent metric by a measured amount while holding cost per run flat; record before and after.

topics.title: Cloud and production
topics.objective: Run the solution on Azure with a real delivery pipeline.
topics.summary: Azure fundamentals, Container Apps, managed PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions CI/CD, environment separation, secrets, deployment strategies, rollbacks and production monitoring.
topics.assignment: Deploy LedgerSync to Azure Container Apps with managed PostgreSQL via GitHub Actions, separate dev and prod, and perform a rollback on purpose.

topics.title: Enterprise identity and security
topics.objective: Integrate with enterprise identity and prove access is right.
topics.summary: Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth2 and OIDC integration, RBAC, tenant isolation, IAM, data security, auditability and secure integration patterns.
topics.assignment: Replace local auth with Entra ID sign-in; map Entra groups to LedgerSync roles; run an access review and record the evidence.

topics.title: Enterprise architecture
topics.objective: Communicate and defend architecture decisions to engineers and executives.
topics.summary: System design, C4 diagrams, ADRs, components, data flows, API boundaries, build versus buy, scalability, reliability, maintainability, cost and latency trade-offs, technical debt.
topics.assignment: Produce C4 context, container and component diagrams for LedgerSync, five ADRs including one build-versus-buy decision, and present them to a peer for challenge.

topics.title: AI governance and operating model
topics.objective: Own the solution in production and prove its value.
topics.summary: AI and data governance, responsible AI, privacy and compliance, model lifecycle, evaluation governance, access reviews, operational ownership, business value measurement and support.
topics.assignment: Write the operating model: owners, model change process gated by evals, access-review cadence, support runbook, and a business-value measure (hours saved per close) tracked from real usage.
